decisions.reason: Designer selection of the board orientation for connector layout does not change DCDC1 voltage, rail regulation, supplied loads, or compensation behavior.
The source delegates overall board orientation but does not change the panel power-button connector, its integrated-board location, signal, or control behavior.
Board orientation and enclosure-fit strategy do not alter BOM readiness, component sourcing, population rules, or approved component specifications.
The source does not change the charge-status display method, dedicated charge LED interface, connector specification, or associated circuit values.
